description: This file contains unit test cases for the onboarding process, focusing on remote authentication prompts, error handling, and UI rule logic within the OpenClaw SDK project.

classes.name: OnboardingRemoteAuthPromptTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing multiple test cases related to onboarding remote authentication prompts and error mapping.

methods.name: auth detail codes map to remote auth issues
methods.description: Tests mapping of specific GatewayConnectAuthError detail codes to RemoteGatewayAuthIssue enum cases.

methods.name: password detail family maps to password required issue
methods.description: Tests mapping of password-related GatewayConnectAuthError instances to passwordRequired issue.

methods.name: token field visibility follows onboarding rules
methods.description: Verifies the conditions under which the remote token field is visible in the onboarding UI based on various parameters.

methods.name: pairing required copy points users to pair approve
methods.description: Checks the text content and links in the pairing required issue's UI copy.

methods.name: paired device success copy explains auth source
methods.description: Validates the title and detail text for different authentication sources upon successful pairing.

methods.name: transient probe mode restore does not clear probe feedback
methods.description: Asserts that probe feedback is not reset in certain probe modes when suppression is not active.
